The '''Tub o' Flowers''' is a [[Crafting|crafted]] piece of [[Furniture]] that blooms in the [[Spring]] and [[Summer]].  Both the Tub o' Flowers and its recipe can be purchased from [[Pierre]] at the [[Flower Dance]].

==Note==
The seeds required for this crafting recipe cost {{Price|200}} at [[Pierre's General Store]] when bought in the correct season.

==History==
{{History|1.3.27|Price reduced from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|250}}, recipe price reduced from {{Price|2000}} to {{Price|1000}}.}}
{{History|1.4|Can now be stacked in a player's [[inventory]] and in [[Chest|chests]].}}
{{History|1.6|Now shows the correct (in bloom) sprite on the day it's placed. Now always blooms indoors.}}
